theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (τ : Euclidean N → Grassmannian N n), Measurable τ → (∀ (A : Set (Euclidean N)) (β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ)), MeasurableSet A → (∀ S, 0 ≤ β S) → ∫⁻ z in A ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), ENNReal.ofReal (β z.2) ∂V.measure = ∫⁻ x in A, ENNReal.ofReal (β (τ x)) ∂V.weight) → V.measure = V.weight.map (fun x ↦ (x, τ x))
